title: Bayesian Operator Learning: Posterior Existence and Convergence of Point Estimates for Gaussian Priors
summary: We develop a Bayesian framework for learning nonlinear operators between infinite-dimensional spaces. Given a map $g_0:\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{Y}$ between separable Hilbert spaces, we study the recovery of $g_0$ from $n\in\mathbb{N}$ noisy input-output pairs $(\boldsymbol{X},\boldsymbol{Z})=(X_i,Z_i)_{i=1}^n$ with $Z_i= g_0 (X_i ) + E_i$. Here the $X_i\in\mathcal{X}$ are randomly drawn 'design' points in a compact subset of $\mathcal X$, and the $E_i$ are assumed to be i.i.d. draws from a Gaussian white noise process indexed by $\mathcal{Y}$.
